citation: Treaty of General Relations between the United States and the Republic of the Philippines, signed July 4, 1946, with Protocol, 61 Stat. 1174 (ratifications exchanged and in force Oct. 22, 1946)
note: Branch B20 (52 Philippine members): article I surrenders all remaining U.S. rights of possession and control except base use by agreement; fixes the 1946-10-22 upper bound for naval reservations and bases withheld under the 1944 joint resolution. Read on the web only.

citation: Joint Resolution of June 29, 1944, ch. 322, sec. 2, 58 Stat. 626 (22 U.S.C. 1392)
note: Branch B20: authority to withhold or acquire and retain Philippine bases beyond those of the 1934 Act; explains why some Army reservations were not surrendered on July 4, 1946. Read on the web (LII) only.

citation: Panama Canal Treaty, signed Sept. 7, 1977, arts. I, II, IV, XI, 33 U.S.T. 39, T.I.A.S. No. 10030, 1280 U.N.T.S. No. 21086 (in force Oct. 1, 1979)
note: Branch B21 (12 Canal Zone members): entry into force Oct. 1, 1979; termination of the 1903 Convention (art. I(1)(a)); Panama reassumes plenary jurisdiction over the former Canal Zone (art. XI); termination Dec. 31, 1999 (art. II). Read on the web only.

citation: Act of July 5, 1884, ch. 214, sec. 1, 23 Stat. 103 (disposal of abandoned and useless military reservations)
note: Branch B11 (55 members) and mechanism M2: authority for placing reservation lands under the Secretary of the Interior for disposition. Read on the web only.

citation: Hawaii Admission Act, Pub. L. 86-3, sec. 5(c), 5(e), 73 Stat. 4, 5-6 (1959)
note: Branch B30 (25 Hawaii members, open) and B12: lands set aside by executive order remained U.S. property at statehood; five-year report and conveyance to the State of lands no longer needed. Read on the web only.

Mechanism M8 (continuity only): defense withdrawals over 5,000 acres on and after Feb. 28, 1958 need an Act of Congress; prospective, neither ends nor confirms earlier reservations. Read on the web (LII) only.

citation: Agreement between the United States and the Republic of the Philippines concerning Military Bases, signed Mar. 14, 1947, 43 U.N.T.S. No. 673 (Statutes at Large citation to be confirmed on acquisition)
note: Branch B20 gap: tests the doctrine's position that post-1946 U.S. use of retained Philippine bases rested on this agreement rather than on the reserving executive orders. Not read.
